title_draft: Zad Archery on Steam Deck: Compatibility and Caveats
quick_answer_draft: Zad Archery is rated Playable on Steam Deck. Steam’s compatibility data says all functionality is accessible with the default controller configuration, text is legible and the default graphics configuration performs well. The main caveat is that some non-Deck controller icons may appear.

claims.text: Steam compatibility metadata marks Zad Archery as Playable.
Default controller configuration can access all functionality.
Interface text is legible and default graphics settings perform well.
Some controller glyphs shown by the game may not match Steam Deck buttons.

faq.q: Is Zad Archery Steam Deck Verified?
faq.a: The current compatibility category is Playable, not Verified.

faq.q: Do you need mouse and keyboard?
faq.a: Steam metadata says all functionality is accessible with the default controller configuration.
